resources.string: Automatically sync Wenku8 volume progress. Bangumi stays Reading; local reading status is unchanged.
Link a Wenku8 book here to start automatic syncing.
No unlinked books with a saved catalog. Open a Wenku8 book to load its catalog first.
Completed volume changes are combined for 30 seconds before syncing. Network failures retry automatically.
The latest 100 results are stored on this device. Success means remote progress was verified. Clearing reading records or old logs keeps confirmed volumes; rereading does not count them again.
Access denied. Check your account permissions.
Too many requests. Retrying after the server delay.
Bangumi is temporarily unavailable. Retrying automatically.
Connection interrupted or timed out; no complete response received.
Could not read the Bangumi response. Sync paused; retry later.
The last write needs verification. Remote progress will be checked before sending again.

Confirm the included volumes and complete catalogs. Illustrations and afterwords are excluded. The latest unfinished volume waits for confirmation; 0 total means unknown. Split volumes can count as one.
Bangumi already records %1$d volumes. Check which volumes this represents; local chapters will stay unchanged.
Confirming will change this Bangumi collection to Reading.
You can search now. Connect an account before confirming a link.
Book title, Bangumi URL or ID
No novel found. Try an alternate title or a subject link.
This is a single book entry and can track only one publication. Choose the novel series to track multiple volumes.
Author differs; check the work or edition.
Stop syncing and remove the token from this device. Collections remain on Bangumi. Revoke the token on its official page if needed.
Stop syncing this book. Its Bangumi collection and local reading progress will remain.
Remote progress is ahead; it will not be lowered.
Remote progress or account changed. Review the link to continue.
Catalog changed. Review the volume mapping to continue.
Bangumi is no longer Reading. Review the link to resume.
Collection not found or unavailable. Review the link.
Request incomplete; sync paused. Review the link or retry.
Waiting to retry; local reading is saved.
Token expired or invalid. Reconnect your account.
Saved authorization could not be opened. Reconnect your account.
Could not reach Bangumi. Check your connection and retry.
Could not complete this operation. Reload the catalog and check the link and previously read volumes.
